doc: Mano's journal (V2-08; Menus.show_journal). `dijkstra`: the half-finished notes on the first page, `margin`: the line in its margin. `people`: one kind line per friend in Mano's voice, the first whose `when` holds (they change over the night); each was reviewed by that friend, like a [slot] line. `duck_tips`: the duck page once all twelve are found (docs/DESIGN.md §3.8). `side`: the four side stories, each shown once `seen` holds, ticked once `done` holds.

for each v next to u: relax(u, v)  if dist[u] + w < dist[v]
